items.summary: Update ShortSportPage to support TikTok-style vertical manual scrolling, where users can swipe or scroll up/down to navigate between video reels one at a time with snap-scrolling behavior.

Add a floating auto-scroll toggle button in the bottom-right corner of ShortSportPage. When activated, the page automatically advances to the next reel at a set interval. Clicking the button again stops auto-scrolling. The button should visually indicate its active/inactive state.
